tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search published backflow testers by text, place and category.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one published backflow tester by its slug.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List countries, regions and cities that have backflow testers.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories with their backflow tester counts.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get the number of published backflow testers, places and categories, and when the data last changed.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List where the backflow tester data comes from, with the license and refresh of each source.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the products, with the price each had on the day it was checked. Filter by product category.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its slug, with its page and outbound link.

tools.name: list_product_categories
tools.description: List the product categories with their product counts.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the published academy courses with their level, length, pass mark and certificate validity.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Get one published academy course by its slug, with its objectives, lessons and FAQ. Exam questions and answers are never returned.
